description:
Black wireless earbuds with wireless charging case are made for everyday listening—commutes, office calls, gym walks, and late-night reels. The in‑ear TWS design sits snug for passive noise isolation and a secure feel, while the tuned sound delivers clear vocals with a punchy bass kick that makes music and videos feel fuller. Bluetooth 5.0 keeps pairing stable with Android and iPhone, so your audio stays smooth when you move around.

Tap to control play/pause, skip tracks, answer calls, and trigger your phone’s voice assistant. When the battery runs low, drop the case on a compatible wireless charging pad or plug in a cable—no fuss, no messy wires when you don’t want them. If you want a premium-looking black earbuds set that’s simple, pocketable, and reliable day after day, this is the easy upgrade.

features: Premium black TWS design for daily carry: Clean, modern look with a compact case that slips into pockets and small bags.

Balanced sound with deep bass feel: Clear vocals for podcasts and calls, plus enhanced bass for music, movies, and short videos.
In-ear fit for passive noise isolation: Helps reduce outside noise naturally for better focus on music (no ANC).
Touch controls on earbuds: Tap to play/pause, change tracks, answer/end calls, and access voice assistant on compatible phones.
Built-in microphone for everyday calls: Designed for routine calling and meetings while you’re on the move.
Wireless + wired case charging: Charge the case on a compatible wireless pad or use a cable when you need a faster plug-in top-up.
Simple, no-complication usability: Essential features done right—great for students, office users, and daily commuters.
